_doc: CLI client conformance (SPEC §7G.10, §7G.11) over conformance/media/fake-cli/fake-cli.sh — see fake-cli/README.md for the exact harness steps. style = a preset. Placeholders: {out} the fake's out dir, {dir} gather.dir, {cwd} in expectArgv = must equal <out>/cwd.txt byte for byte after removing its one trailing newline (the fake writes `pwd -P`; D17: the client passes the realpath of its temp dir, so no symlink resolution on either side). command (when present) replaces the fake command entirely (spawn-failure case). env is set in the TEST process (the child inherits it; Codex's folder lookup reads it). expectExists / expectMissing: paths that must / must not exist after the run. expectNoSpawn: argv.txt must not exist. maxElapsedMs: the call must return within it (kill on timeout). Other fields as in clients.json. modelParts (SPEC §7G.6 model visibility): the parts of this tool result that message assembly (§8A) emits to the model — only image parts; video/audio parts stay in RunResult.files and toolCalls[].parts only. Assert with the port's assembly function on a transcript containing this tool result. ctxTimeoutMs (D12): function face only, ctx.deadline = now + ctxTimeoutMs; errorPrefix asserts the message start. D9 (SPEC §7G.12): when modelParts is [] the tool-result content the port sends to the model is the plain output string in every message style incl. Anthropic — never an empty content array, never a placeholder; assert it with the same assembly function. D19: a CLI client that does not accept a canonical arg is skipped (never spawned) ⇒ the joined 'media: no client available for …' error. D20 runFilePath / D21 noUsage: as in clients.json. D21: Grok's end event: usage.input_tokens ⇒ inputTokens, usage.output_tokens ⇒ outputTokens, total_cost_usd ⇒ costUsd, total_cost_usd_ticks ⇒ raw.total_cost_usd_ticks (verbatim); each only when present. D20 runFilePath is asserted within the tool face; in url mode a CLI file's path is the CLI's own absolute file, not under {dir}. style (instead of client) names a built-in preset loaded with loadMediaStyle(style, config) (xai-grok-cli | openai-codex-cli | google-agy-cli, or a -mock twin); client grok|codex is the same as style xai-grok-cli|openai-codex-cli. oneShot:true ⇒ also run generateMedia(style, verb, args, config) and assert the same result. verbCases: createMedia over the listed styles (a string = preset, an object = an HTTP style); assert verbs() == expectVerbs, tools() names == expectTools, and generate(unsupported, {}) fails with error without starting any process. The unsupported-verb message says 'style' because every source is a loaded style. availabilityCases: loadMediaStyle(style, config) then available() — fast, no generation; assert {installed, loggedIn, reason} exactly. {dir} = a fresh temp dir (realpath); createFiles are created empty first; env set / unsetEnv removed for the case. A CLI's login is the existence of its own auth file (grok ~/.grok/auth.json, codex $CODEX_HOME/auth.json default ~/.codex/auth.json, agy ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/antigravity-oauth-token), never its contents. result.style / result.model are asserted only when the expected result names them.
